resources.string: Every pattern saved. Every project remembered.

Premium adds unlimited pattern imports, unlimited projects and multiple named counters per project.

Free includes 20 pattern imports, 3 unfinished projects, one counter per project, notes, materials requirements and the split-view reader. Previously imported files and existing projects remain accessible after Premium ends.
Subscriptions are unavailable in this build. Your offline workspace is ready to use.

Subscriptions renew through Amazon. Review the billing period and price in Amazon’s purchase confirmation. Manage or cancel in your Amazon account subscriptions. Verified Premium works offline for up to 72 hours before another verification is required. No trial is advertised.

Your patterns and project data stay on this device. No account, advertising or analytics. Only Amazon receipt and account identifiers go to the purchase verification service. Android app data is removed on uninstall; keep original source files or export them before uninstalling.
